tenderSchedule.title: Supplying of Line array Flying Sound System, Lighting System & Generator on Hire Basis For Dasara Cultural Programme Festivities -2026 at Mysuru Palace Premises, Mysore Palace Board, Mysuru.
tenderSchedule.description: Supplying of Line array Flying Sound System, Lighting System & Generator on Hire Basis For Dasara Cultural Programme Festivities -2026 at Mysuru Palace Premises, Mysore Palace Board, Mysuru.

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The bidder should upload Valid Firm /Company Registration Certificate

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bidder should upload GST Certificate
The bidder shall provide Audited Annual Turnover Certificate Certified by CA for previous Five financial years i.e. 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24.& 2024-25
The bidder shall provide documentary proof of IT Returns filed for previous Five financial years i.e. 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24. & 2024-25
The bidder shall provide Audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss statement Certified by CA for previous Five financial years i.e.2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24. & 2024-25

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should havein the last five years i.e.2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24 & 2024-25 achieved in at least two financial years a minimum average annual financial turnover of Rs. 95.00 Lakhs.

Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar work suchas Supplying of Line array Flying Sound System, Stage Lighting System & Generator on Hire Basis for Live Concert only of value not less than Rs. 48.00 Lakhs
The bidder shall have to submit the Similar Nature of Work Experience.Work order & Work Done Certificate and only work order copy will not be considered as Work done certificate.
Work orders which also include other works such as flower decoration, stage, furniture, general lighting will not be considered for single work of similar nature of value 48.00lakhs

Esceuted in ant One year, the minimum quantities of work of Supplying and installing of L-Acoustics, RCF, Meyer Sound, EV, Line Array Flying sound system for a minimum of 25,000 people gathering places.
Executed in any one year, the minimum quantities of work of Supplying and installing of lighting system for 25,000 people gathering places

The tenderer should have a qualified and certified Sound Engineer as world renowned artists will be performing at Mysore Dasara. Certificate of Sound Engineer qualification from certified Audio Institutions to be submitted
Custom made Equipments, Ahuja, Chinese equipments like Nexo, Real, British Acoustics are not acceptable

Each Tenderer should further demonstrate that of Availability by owning at least 50% of the required /specified key and critical equipment for this work and the relevant documents (commitment agreements etc.) for availability for this work are to be uploaded

Each Tenderer should further demonstrate that the remaining 50% can be deployed on lease / hire basis for all works provided, the relevant documents (commitment agreements etc.) for availability for this work are to be uploaded

Cultural Programs are organized during the Dasara Festivities-2026 fromm 11/10/2026 to 20/10/2026. If the program dates were changed, Bidder should be ready to carry out the work on the changed dates.
Work should be carried out as per the directions of Engineer in charge and to be completed within Specified date and time from the date of work order.

Care should be taken while carrying out the work and should not damage any properties /assets of the Mysore Palace Board. If any damage occurs same has to be set righted by the Agency at their own cost.
If any accident occurs to Tenderer personnels, Tenderer will be whole responsible and Mysore Palace Board will not give any compensation to the injurer
Deputy Director, Palace Board, Mysore reserves the right to Accept or Reject the tender without giving any reasons.
The amount quoted by the tenderer should be Exclusive of GST.
The contract is covered by Mysore Palace Board terms and conditions. In the event of any conflict or inconsistency the MPB terms and conditions shall prevail.

The Tenderer Shall provide Suitable Tech Rider, Keyboards and Sound Equipments required by internationally reputed artists who are performing in Dasara 2026 Cultural Programs and as they are not be ready for any quality compromise in their technical requirements to perform. The Cost shall be bearable by the Tenderer itself & Mysuru Palace Board is not resposible for this. The Tech Riders specification of all Cultural Programs is Uploaded in the Tender Document.
